children: Coca-Cola executives say consumers appear to be pulling back on restaurants and eating more at home as affordability concerns ramp up. "While our own business continues to have a lot of momentum across those channels, I think the underlying pressure across the consumer landscape is there," finance chief John Murphy says during a call with analysts. Murphy says he expects that pressure to continue for the rest of the year heading into 2027. (kelly.cloonan@wsj.com)
